85:         """Analyze the applications in the model.
86: 
87:         Applications that must be upgraded in a specific order will be returned first, followed
88:         by applications that can be upgraded in any order. Applications that are not supported
89:         will be ignored.
90: 
91:         :param model_name: Name of model to query
92:         :type model_name: Optional[str]
93:         :return: Application objects with their respective information.
94:         :rtype: List[OpenStackApplication]
95:         """
96:         juju_status = await juju_utils.get_status(model_name)
97:         apps = {
98:             AppFactory.create(
99:                 name=app,
100:                 status=app_status,
101:                 config=await juju_utils.get_application_config(app, model_name),
102:                 model_name=model_name,
103:                 charm=await juju_utils.extract_charm_name(app, model_name),
104:             )
105:             for app, app_status in juju_status.applications.items()
106:         }
107:         # remove non-supported charms that return None on AppFactory.create
108:         apps.discard(None)
109:         # mypy complains that apps can have None, but we already removed.
110:         apps_to_upgrade_in_order = {
111:             app for app in apps if app.charm in UPGRADE_ORDER  # type: ignore
112:         }
113:         other_o7k_apps = apps - apps_to_upgrade_in_order
114:         sorted_apps_to_upgrade_in_order = sorted(
115:             apps_to_upgrade_in_order,
116:             key=lambda app: UPGRADE_ORDER.index(app.charm),  # type: ignore
117:         )
118:         # order by charm name to have a predicable upgrade sequence of others o7k charms.
119:         other_o7k_apps_sorted_by_name = sorted(
120:             other_o7k_apps, key=lambda app: app.charm  # type: ignore
121:         )
122:         return sorted_apps_to_upgrade_in_order + other_o7k_apps_sorted_by_name  # type: ignore

42:     plan = UpgradeStep(description="Top level plan", parallel=False, function=None)
43:     plan.add_step(
44:         UpgradeStep(description="backup mysql databases", parallel=False, function=backup)
45:     )
46: 
47:     principal_upgrade_plan = await create_upgrade_group(
48:         analysis_result=analysis_result,
49:         description="Principal(s) upgrade plan",
50:         target=target,
51:         filter_function=lambda app: not isinstance(app, OpenStackSubordinateApplication),
52:     )
53:     plan.add_step(principal_upgrade_plan)
54: 
55:     subordinate_upgrade_plan = await create_upgrade_group(
56:         analysis_result=analysis_result,
57:         description="Subordinate(s) upgrade plan",
58:         target=target,
59:         filter_function=lambda app: isinstance(app, OpenStackSubordinateApplication),
60:     )
61:     plan.add_step(subordinate_upgrade_plan)

63:     return plan

66: async def create_upgrade_group(
67:     analysis_result: Analysis,
68:     target: str,
69:     description: str,
70:     filter_function: Callable[[OpenStackApplication], bool],
71: ) -> UpgradeStep:
72:     """Create upgrade group.
73: 
74:     :param analysis_result: Result of the analysis.
75:     :type analysis_result: Analysis
76:     :param target: Target OpenStack version.
77:     :type target: str
78:     :param description: Description of the upgrade step.
79:     :type description: str
80:     :param filter_function: Function to filter applications.
81:     :type filter_function: Callable[[OpenStackApplication], bool]
82:     :return: Upgrade group.
83:     :rtype: UpgradeStep
84:     """
85:     group_upgrade_plan = UpgradeStep(description=description, parallel=False, function=None)
86:     for app in filter(filter_function, analysis_result.apps_control_plane):
87:         try:
88:             app_upgrade_plan = app.generate_upgrade_plan(target)
89:         except HaltUpgradePlanGeneration as exc:
90:             # we do not care if applications halt the upgrade plan generation
91:             # for some known reason.
92:             logger.debug("'%s' halted the upgrade planning generation: %s", app.name, exc)
93:             app_upgrade_plan = None
94:         except Exception as exc:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
95:             logger.error("Cannot generate upgrade plan for '%s': %s", app.name, exc)
96:             raise
97:         if app_upgrade_plan:
98:             group_upgrade_plan.add_step(app_upgrade_plan)
99: 
100:     return group_upgrade_plan
